description: Play Tic Tac Toe on the whiteboard. Actions: "start" sets up the board (piece defaults to X), "move" places the current turn's piece in cell 1-9, "state" shows the current board, "end" closes the game. The board renders visually on the whiteboard. X always goes first. Returns ASCII board + game status after each action.

action.description: Game action. "start" = set up board (optional piece: X or O). "move" = place piece (requires cell 1-9). "state" = get current board. "end" = tear down game.

piece.description: Which piece you play as (for "start" action). Default: X. X always goes first.

name: tictactoe
